back: A molecule or ion with a lone pair that forms a dative (coordinate) bond to a central metal atom or ion.
The number of dative bonds from ligands to the central metal ion (not the number of ligands).
Bidentate: 1,2-diaminoethane (en, two N) and ethanedioate (C₂O₄²⁻, two O). Hexadentate: EDTA⁴⁻ (four O, two N).
2: linear 180°. 4: tetrahedral 109.5° or square planar 90°. 6: octahedral 90°.
Oxidation state of the metal + sum of the ligand charges, e.g. [Fe(CN)₆]: +3 − 6 = 3−.
Pale blue precipitate, then deep blue solution of [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ (only four water ligands replaced).
[Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺ + 4Cl⁻ ⇌ [CuCl₄]²⁻ + 6H₂O: pale blue to yellow-green, then yellow; octahedral to tetrahedral.
Blue precipitate, then straw-coloured [Co(NH₃)₆]²⁺, which darkens in air as it is oxidised to [Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺.
